result.finding: H2 primary correlation (approaches [9]-[10]) over the 50 chemicals recorded in evi-obs-20261008-h2-sample. Encoding on the hydrogen-suppressed graph of each CompTox QSAR-ready SMILES (RDKit 2025.09.4; heavy atoms only, bond orders ignored): code = product over heavy atoms of p(Z)^deg, p(Z) the Z-th prime (C 13, N 17, O 19, F 23, P 47, S 53, Cl 59, Br 149, I 241; checked by computing the primes), deg = number of heavy-atom neighbours; the code is an exact Python integer and log10(code) = sum of deg x log10 p(Z). Ranks were taken on the exact integer codes, ties given average ranks; measured log Kow as recorded in approach [5]. Spearman rho = Pearson correlation of the two average-rank vectors = 0.617646, n = 50. Tied code groups: 3 (6 chemicals): 95-94-3 = 634-66-2; 108-38-3 = 100-42-5; 91-20-3 = 91-17-8. Tied log Kow groups: 2. Result.point = rho. Pre-registered bearing: supports if rho >= 0.5, refutes otherwise -> supports. SciPy spearmanr on log10(code) gives the same value.
